1484	/-! ## `PoolInv` read literally (material §4) -/
1485	
1486	/-- Second clause of `PoolInv` (material §4), literally, for the pool `pl`: every active authority
1487	derived from a companion of the pool and covering a leaf of an entry "porte la génération courante
1488	de l'entrée": it is, or descends from, an entry authority of that entry tagged with its current
1489	generation; and the entry is live. -/
1490	def PoolInvGen (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
1491	  ∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.pool = pl.id → ∀ j ∈ List.range ps.s.A.length, ps.s.Active j →
1492	    r.comp ∈ ps.s.ancs j → ∀ i ∈ List.range pl.slots.length,
1493	      (∃ l ∈ ps.s.afp j, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i)) →
1494	      OptP (pl.slots[i]?) (fun sl => sl.live = true ∧ ∃ e ∈ r.entries, e.2.1 = i ∧
1495	        e.2.2 = sl.gen ∧ (e.1 = j ∨ e.1 ∈ ps.s.ancs j)) False
1496	
1497	instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvGen ps pl) := by
1498	  unfold PoolInvGen; infer_instance
1499	
1500	/-- Third clause of `PoolInv` (material §4), literally, for the pool `pl`: "toute compagne active a
1501	au plus les autorités d'entrée de sa résolution pour descendants", read on active descendants. -/
1502	def PoolInvDesc (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
1503	  ∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.pool = pl.id → ps.s.Active r.comp → ∀ j ∈ List.range ps.s.A.length,
1504	    ps.s.Active j → r.comp ∈ ps.s.ancs j → j ∈ r.entries.map (·.1)
1505	
1506	instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvDesc ps pl) := by
1507	  unfold PoolInvDesc; infer_instance
1508	
1509	/-- First clause of `PoolInv` (material §4) for the pool `pl`: entries pairwise disjoint and within
1510	the storage. -/
1511	def PoolInvDisj (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
1512	  (∀ i₁ ∈ List.range pl.slots.length, ∀ i₂ ∈ List.range pl.slots.length, i₁ ≠ i₂ →
1513	    ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i₁), l ∉ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i₂)) ∧
1514	  ∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P pl.storage
1515	
1516	instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvDisj ps pl) := by
1517	  unfold PoolInvDisj; infer_instance
1518	
1519	/-- `PoolInv` of the material (§4), literally, for every live pool (`internal` active): the three
1520	clauses `PoolInvDisj`, `PoolInvGen` and `PoolInvDesc`. -/
1521	def PoolInv (ps : PS) : Prop :=
1522	  ∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, ps.s.Active pl.internal →
1523	    PoolInvDisj ps pl ∧ PoolInvGen ps pl ∧ PoolInvDesc ps pl
1524	
1525	instance (ps : PS) : Decidable (PoolInv ps) := by unfold PoolInv; infer_instance

1527	/-! ## Executable steps
1528	
1529	A decidable step function for the extended machine, used by the case files to build reached
1530	states: `prun` runs a list of operations and returns the final state when every step is `ok`
1531	(`prun_reach`). -/
1532	
1533	/-- An operation of the extended machine with its arguments: the steps of `Reachable`
1534	(MM-03.3 §3–6) and the pool operations (material §4). -/
1535	inductive Op where
1536	  | derive (src q : Nat) (m : Mode)
1537	  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
1538	  | release (a : Nat)
1539	  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
1540	  | depend (q x : Nat)
1541	  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
1542	  | exit
1543	  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
1544	  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
1545	  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
1546	  | pin (p : Nat)
1547	  | unpin (p : Nat)
1548	  | endUse (p : Nat)
1549	  | free (p auth : Nat)
1550	  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
1551	  | store (a p : Nat)
1552	  | newArena (st i : Nat)
1553	  | issue (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
1554	  | reset (i via : Nat)
1555	  | newPool (st i : Nat)
1556	  | allocSlot (j via dst : Nat)
1557	  | resolve (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode)
1558	  | resolveMany (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode)
1559	  | unresolve (c : Nat)
1560	  | freeSlot (j via : Nat) (h : Handle)

1562	section Exec
1563	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
1564	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
1565	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
1566	
1567	/-- `ok` outcome of a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §3–6), `none` otherwise. -/
1568	def kexec (s : S3) : Op → Option S3
1569	  | .derive src q m => if DerivePre s src q m then some (deriveEff s src q m) else none
1570	  | .split src rs => if SplitPre k s src rs then some (splitEff s src rs) else none
1571	  | .release a => if ReleasePre s a then some (releaseEff s a) else none
1572	  | .transfer src dst => if TransferPre k s src dst then some (transferEff s src dst) else none
1573	  | .depend q x => if DependPre s q x then some (dependEff s q x) else none
1574	  | .enter ps ls => if EnterPre s ps ls then some (enterEff s ps ls) else none
1575	  | .exit => if ExitPre k s then some (exitEff s) else none
1576	  | .read a ls => if canRead3 s a ls then some s else none
1577	  | .write a ls => if canWrite3 s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
1578	  | .writeShared a ls => if WriteSharedPre k s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
1579	  | .pin p => if PinPre s p then some (pinEff s p true) else none
1580	  | .unpin p => if UnpinPre k s p then some (pinEff s p false) else none
1581	  | .endUse p => if EndUsePre k s p then some (endUseEff s p) else none
1582	  | .free p auth => if FreePre k s p auth then some (freeEff s p) else none
1583	  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
1584	    if AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s then some (allocEff s pr ow ls) else none
1585	  | .store a p => if StorePre s a p then some (storeEff s a p) else none
1586	  | .newArena st i => if NewArenaPre s st i then some (newArenaEff s st i) else none
1587	  | .issue i via region dst =>
1588	    match s.arenas[i]? with
1589	    | some ar =>
1590	      if IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧ Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧
1591	          AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 then
1592	        some (arenaSet (issueEff s ar region dst).1 i (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
1593	      else none
1594	    | none => none
1595	  | .reset i via => if ResetAtPre k s i via then some (resetAtEff s i) else none
1596	  | _ => none
1597	
1598	/-- `ok` outcome of a step of the extended machine, `none` otherwise. -/
1599	def pexec (ps : PS) : Op → Option PS
1600	  | .newPool st i => if NewPoolPre ps.s st i then some (newPoolEff ps st i) else none
1601	  | .allocSlot j via dst =>
1602	    match ps.pools[j]? with
1603	    | some pl =>
1604	      if AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst then
1605	        match firstFree pl with
1606	        | some i => (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst
1607	        | none => none
1608	      else none
1609	    | none => none
1610	  | .resolve j h m =>
1611	    match ps.pools[j]? with
1612	    | some pl =>
1613	      match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
1614	      | some sl =>
1615	        if ResolveRight ps.s pl m ∧ HandleOK pl h ∧
1616	            DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m then
1617	          some { ps with
1618	            s := resolveS ps.s pl sl.place m
1619	            res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
1620	              [(ps.s.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] }
1621	        else none
1622	      | none => none
1623	    | none => none
1624	  | .resolveMany j hs m =>
1625	    match ps.pools[j]? with
1626	    | some pl =>
1627	      if ResolveRight ps.s pl m ∧ BatchOK pl hs ∧
1628	          SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
1629	            (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) then
1630	        some { ps with
1631	          s := resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m
1632	          res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
1633	            batchEntries ps.s.A.length hs⟩] }
1634	      else none
1635	    | none => none
1636	  | .unresolve c =>
1637	    match findRes ps c with
1638	    | some r => (releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp])).map fun s' => { ps with s := s' }
1639	    | none => none
1640	  | .freeSlot j via h =>
1641	    match ps.pools[j]? with
1642	    | some pl =>
1643	      match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
1644	      | some sl =>
1645	        if PoolRight k ps.s pl via ∧ HandleCur pl h ∧ ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place ∧
1646	            EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place then
1647	          some (freeSlotEff ps j pl h.slot sl)
1648	        else none
1649	      | none => none
1650	    | none => none
1651	  | o => (kexec k ps.s o).map fun s' => { ps with s := s' }
1652	
1653	/-- Runs a list of operations; `some` of the final state when every step is `ok`. -/
1654	def prun (ps : PS) : List Op → Option PS
1655	  | [] => some ps
1656	  | o :: os => (pexec k ps o).bind fun ps' => prun ps' os
1657	
1658	end Exec

1661	variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
1662	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
1663	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

1665	theorem kexec_step {s s' : S3} {o : Op} (h : kexec k s o = some s') : Step k s s' := by
1666	  cases o <;> simp only [kexec] at h
1667	  all_goals first
1668	    | (split at h
1669	       · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
1670	         first
1671	           | exact .kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok hp))
1672	           | exact .kernel (.split (Guarded.ok hp))
1673	           | exact .kernel (.release (Guarded.ok hp))
1674	           | exact .kernel (.transfer (Guarded.ok hp))
1675	           | exact .kernel (.depend (Guarded.ok hp))
1676	           | exact .kernel (.enter (Guarded.ok hp))
1677	           | exact .kernel (.exit (Guarded.ok hp))
1678	           | exact .kernel (.read (Guarded.ok hp))
1679	           | exact .kernel (.write (Guarded.ok hp))
1680	           | exact .kernel (.writeShared (Guarded.ok hp))
1681	           | exact .kernel (.pin (Guarded.ok hp))
1682	           | exact .kernel (.unpin (Guarded.ok hp))
1683	           | exact .kernel (.endUse (Guarded.ok hp))
1684	           | exact .kernel (.free (Guarded.ok hp))
1685	           | exact .kernel (.alloc (.ok hp.1 hp.2))
1686	           | exact .kernel (.store (Guarded.ok hp))
1687	           | exact .newArena (Guarded.ok hp)
1688	           | exact .reset (Guarded.ok hp)
1689	       · cases h)
1690	    | cases h
1691	    | (split at h
1692	       · rename_i ar har
1693	         split at h
1694	         · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
1695	           exact .issue (.ok har (.ok hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2))
1696	         · cases h
1697	       · cases h)

1700	  cases o
1701	  case newPool st i =>
1702	    simp only [pexec] at h; split at h
1703	    · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact .newPool (Guarded.ok hp)
1704	    · cases h
1705	  case allocSlot j via dst =>
1706	    simp only [pexec] at h
1707	    split at h
1708	    · rename_i pl hpl
1709	      split at h
1710	      · rename_i hst
1711	        split at h
1712	        · rename_i i hi
1713	          cases hsl : pl.slots[i]? with
1714	          | none => rw [hsl] at h; cases h
1715	          | some sl =>
1716	            rw [hsl] at h; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
1717	            exact .allocSlot (.ok hpl hst hi hsl)
1718	        · cases h
1719	      · cases h
1720	    · cases h

1723	    split at h
1724	    · rename_i pl hpl

1726	      · rename_i sl hsl
1727	        split at h
1728	        · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
1729	          exact .resolve (.ok hpl hp.1 hp.2.1 hsl hp.2.2)
1730	        · cases h
1731	      · cases h

1736	    · rename_i pl hpl

1738	      · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
1739	        exact .resolveMany (.ok hpl hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2)
1740	      · cases h
1741	    · cases h
1742	  case unresolve c =>
1743	    simp only [pexec] at h
1744	    split at h
1745	    · rename_i r hr
1746	      cases hs : releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) with
1747	      | none => rw [hs] at h; cases h
1748	      | some s' =>
1749	        rw [hs] at h; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
1750	        exact .unresolve (.ok hr hs)
1751	    · cases h
1752	  case freeSlot j via hd =>

1754	    split at h
1755	    · rename_i pl hpl
1756	      split at h
1757	      · rename_i sl hsl
1758	        split at h
1759	        · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
1760	          exact .freeSlot (.ok hpl hp.1 hp.2.1 hsl hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2)

1762	      · cases h

1764	  all_goals
1765	    simp only [pexec] at h
1766	    cases hk : kexec k ps.s _ with
1767	    | none => rw [hk] at h; cases h
1768	    | some s' =>
1769	      rw [hk] at h; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h

1772	theorem prun_reach {statics : Statics} : ∀ {ps ps' : PS} {os : List Op}, PReach k statics ps →
1773	    prun k ps os = some ps' → PReach k statics ps'

1776	    simp only [prun] at h

1778	    | none => rw [he] at h; cases h
1779	    | some ps₁ => rw [he] at h; exact prun_reach (.step hr (pexec_step he)) h

1795	/-! ## `PoolInv` is not preserved (material §4, `pool_inv_preserved`)
1796	
1797	Two reached runs, kept as counterexamples. In both, a frame has an allocator 0, the pool value 1
1798	and leaves for handles; the storage allocated by 0 for the pool value has two entries, and its root
1799	authority, held by the pool value, is `internal`; entry 0 is allocated (handle `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`) and
1800	resolved `Modify`. -/

1802	namespace PoolInvCex
1803	
1804	/-- Pool value 1, handle leaf 2, storage 3 with entries 4 and 5, `internal` 3; companion 4 and entry
1805	authority 5 on the place 4 of entry 0. -/
1806	def ops : List Op :=
1807	  [.enter [] [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
1808	    .alloc 0 1 [(none, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0)], .newPool 3 3,
1809	    .allocSlot 0 0 2, .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify]

1811	def s0 : PS := (prun K0 (PS.init []) ops).getD (PS.init [])

1813	/-- The program derives from the companion 4 an authority 6, `Modify`, on the place 5 of entry 1,
1814	which is free (MM-03.3 §3, O1: accepted by the kernel). -/
1815	def s1 : PS := (pexec K0 s0 (.derive 4 5 .modify)).getD s0
1816	
1817	/-- The pool of `s0` and `s1`. -/
1818	def pl : Pool := ⟨0, 3, 3, [⟨4, 0, true⟩, ⟨5, 0, false⟩]⟩
1819	
1820	theorem reach0 : PReach K0 [] s0 := prun_init (by decide) (some_getD (by decide))
1821	
1822	theorem step01 : PStep K0 s0 s1 := pexec_step (some_getD (by decide))
1823	
1824	end PoolInvCex
1825	
1826	/-- `pool_inv_preserved` (material §4) is false for `PoolInv` read literally: from a reached state
1827	where it holds, a kernel `derive` from the companion (MM-03.3 §3, O1) gives an active authority
1828	derived from the companion on a free entry (second clause) that is no entry authority (third
1829	clause). The first clause still holds. -/
1830	theorem pool_inv_not_preserved : ∃ ps ps', PReach K0 [] ps ∧ PoolInv ps ∧ PStep K0 ps ps' ∧
1831	    ¬ PoolInv ps' :=
1832	  ⟨_, _, PoolInvCex.reach0, by decide, PoolInvCex.step01, by decide⟩
1833	
1834	/-- The clauses of `PoolInv` in the counterexample after the `derive`: the pool is live, entries
1835	disjoint, the second and third clauses false. -/
1836	theorem pool_inv_cex_clauses :
1837	    PoolInvCex.s1.pools = [PoolInvCex.pl] ∧ PoolInvCex.s1.s.Active 3 ∧
1838	    PoolInvDisj PoolInvCex.s1 PoolInvCex.pl ∧ ¬ PoolInvGen PoolInvCex.s1 PoolInvCex.pl ∧
1839	    ¬ PoolInvDesc PoolInvCex.s1 PoolInvCex.pl := by decide
1840	
1841	namespace PoolInvCex2
1842	
1843	/-- Pool value 1, handle leaf 2, caller leaf 3, storage 4 with entries 5 and 6, `internal` 4;
1844	companion 5 and entry authority 6 on the place 5 of entry 0; the caller derives 7 on its leaf 3 and
1845	calls a frame with the parameters 6 and 7 (G1 holds: the companion is held by the caller). -/
1846	def ops : List Op :=
1847	  [.enter [] [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)], .write 0 [0],
1848	    .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)],
1849	    .newPool 4 4, .allocSlot 0 0 2, .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .derive 3 3 .modify,
1850	    .enter [6, 7] []]
1851	
1852	def s0 : PS := (prun K0 (PS.init []) ops).getD (PS.init [])
1853	
1854	/-- The callee derives 8, `Modify`, from the entry authority 6 on the place 5 of entry 0. -/
1855	def s1 : PS := (pexec K0 s0 (.derive 6 5 .modify)).getD s0
1856	
1857	/-- The callee stores 8 into the caller leaf 3 (MM-03.3 §3, O8). -/
1858	def s2 : PS := (pexec K0 s1 (.store 8 3)).getD s1
1859	
1860	/-- `exitFrame` (O7): the entry authority 6 dies with the callee; 8 survives in the leaf 3 and is
1861	re-attached to its first surviving ancestor, the companion 5. -/
1862	def s3 : PS := (pexec K0 s2 .exit).getD s2
1863	
1864	/-- The pool of these states. -/
1865	def pl : Pool := ⟨0, 4, 4, [⟨5, 0, true⟩, ⟨6, 0, false⟩]⟩
1866	
1867	theorem reach0 : PReach K0 [] s0 := prun_init (by decide) (some_getD (by decide))
1868	theorem step01 : PStep K0 s0 s1 := pexec_step (some_getD (by decide))
1869	theorem step12 : PStep K0 s1 s2 := pexec_step (some_getD (by decide))
1870	theorem step23 : PStep K0 s2 s3 := pexec_step (some_getD (by decide))
1871	
1872	end PoolInvCex2
1873	
1874	/-- The third clause of `PoolInv` (read on all active descendants) fails after a `derive` from an
1875	entry authority, the ordinary use of a resolved entry (MM-03.3 §3, O1); the second clause fails after
1876	`exitFrame` re-attaches a surviving derivative of the entry authority to the companion (O7), with no
1877	operation on the companion. -/
1878	theorem pool_inv_cex_entry :
1879	    PReach K0 [] PoolInvCex2.s0 ∧ PoolInv PoolInvCex2.s0 ∧ PStep K0 PoolInvCex2.s0 PoolInvCex2.s1 ∧
1880	    ¬ PoolInvDesc PoolInvCex2.s1 PoolInvCex2.pl ∧
1881	    PStep K0 PoolInvCex2.s1 PoolInvCex2.s2 ∧ PStep K0 PoolInvCex2.s2 PoolInvCex2.s3 ∧
1882	    PoolInvGen PoolInvCex2.s2 PoolInvCex2.pl ∧ ¬ PoolInvGen PoolInvCex2.s3 PoolInvCex2.pl ∧
1883	    PoolInvCex2.s3.pools = [PoolInvCex2.pl] ∧ PoolInvCex2.s3.s.Active 4 ∧
1884	    PoolInvCex2.s3.s.Active 8 ∧ ¬ PoolInvCex2.s3.s.Active 6 ∧ PoolInvCex2.s3.s.org 8 = some 5 :=
1885	  ⟨PoolInvCex2.reach0, by decide, PoolInvCex2.step01, by decide, PoolInvCex2.step12,
1886	    PoolInvCex2.step23, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
1887	
1888	end Ern.HandlePool

3	/-!
4	# Handle pool (jalon 3, step 1)
5	
6	A library instance of the access discipline, like the arena (MM-03.3 §6): the handle pool of the
7	jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §4). A handle is data and carries no authority. A
8	resolution is a compound borrow made of kernel operations of `Ern.MM03`, which this module does
9	not modify: a companion derived from `internal` on the whole storage, then one entry authority per
10	resolved handle, derived from the companion (`derive` for `resolve`, `split` for `resolveMany`).
11	`unresolve` is a sequence of `release`, `freeSlot` an `endUse` of the entry content, `allocSlot` a
12	`write3` of the handle into its destination. The pool entries live beside the kernel state, like
13	the arena entries of MM-03.3.8 but outside `S3`, so the kernel is unchanged.
14	
15	`PReach` extends `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10) with the pool operations; every pool step is a chain of
16	kernel steps (`pReach_reachable`). Representation choices that the material does not fix are listed
17	in the jalon-3 report, (f).
18	-/
19	
20	namespace Ern.HandlePool
21	
22	open Ern.MM03
23	
24	/-! ## State (material §4) -/
25	
26	/-- Entry of a pool (material §4: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`): `place` is a part of the
27	pool storage. -/
28	structure Slot where
29	  place : Nat
30	  gen : Nat
31	  live : Bool
32	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
33	
34	/-- Pool entry (material §4: `{id, storage, internal, slots}`), abstract like the arena entry of
35	MM-03.3.8. The pool value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (material §4,
36	"même règle que F1"). -/
37	structure Pool where
38	  id : Nat
39	  storage : Nat
40	  internal : Nat
41	  slots : List Slot
42	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
43	
44	/-- Handle (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`): data of fixed size, no authority. -/
45	structure Handle where
46	  id : Nat
47	  slot : Nat
48	  gen : Nat
49	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
50	
51	/-- Ghost record of a resolution (material §4, compound borrow): identity and `internal` of the
52	pool, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities, each tagged with its slot and the
53	resolved generation ("étiquetée de la génération résolue"). Read by no operation except
54	`unresolve`, which looks up the entries of a companion. -/
55	structure Res where
56	  pool : Nat
57	  internal : Nat
58	  comp : Nat
59	  mode : Mode
60	  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
61	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
62	
63	/-- Kernel state with the pool entries (material §4), the next fresh pool identity ("jamais
64	réutilisée pendant l'exécution") and the ghost record of resolutions. -/
65	structure PS where
66	  s : S3
67	  pools : List Pool
68	  nId : Nat
69	  res : List Res
70	
71	/-- Outcomes of a pool operation (material §4: `ok | fail | reject`): `fail` is a defined failure
72	that leaves the state unchanged, as for `alloc` and `issue` (MM-03.3 §3.1). -/
73	inductive POutcome where
74	  | ok (ps : PS)
75	  | fail (ps : PS)
76	  | reject
77	
78	/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse the metadata right
79	and the arena invariant of MM-03.3 §6 (`MetaRight`, `ArenaInv`). -/
80	def Pool.asArena (pl : Pool) : Arena := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩
81	
82	/-- Right to update the pool value (material §4, `allocSlot` and `freeSlot`: "`Modify` exerçable
83	ou `writeShared` sur métadonnées `SharedMutable`"): the metadata right of the arena (MM-03.3 §6,
84	`MetaRight`), read on the holder of `internal`. -/
85	def PoolRight (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) : Prop := MetaRight k s pl.asArena via
86	
87	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) :
88	    Decidable (PoolRight k s pl via) := by
89	  unfold PoolRight; infer_instance
90	
91	/-- Place of slot `i` (0 if the slot does not exist). -/
92	def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0
93	
94	/-- The pool with its slot `i` replaced. -/
95	def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }
96	
97	/-- The extended state with its pool `j` replaced. -/
98	def setPool (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) : PS := { ps with pools := ps.pools.set j pl }
99	
100	/-! ## `newPool storage internal` (material §4) -/
101	
102	/-- Preconditions of `newPool storage internal` (material §4: "préconditions de `newArena` (F1, F2,
103	J1)"): those of `newArena` (MM-03.3 §6, O17), read literally, so clause 4 speaks of the arenas of
104	the state. -/
105	def NewPoolPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop := NewArenaPre s storage internal
106	
107	instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewPoolPre s storage internal) := by
108	  unfold NewPoolPre; infer_instance
109	
110	/-- Effect of `newPool storage internal` (material §4): a pool with a fresh identity, one free
111	entry of generation 0 per child of the storage (the entries are the parts of `storage`, report (f)),
112	and the kernel state unchanged. -/
113	def newPoolEff (ps : PS) (storage internal : Nat) : PS :=
114	  { ps with
115	    pools := ps.pools ++ [⟨ps.nId, storage, internal,
116	      (kids ps.s.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
117	    nId := ps.nId + 1 }
118	
119	/-- `newPool storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (material §4). -/
120	def NewPoolStep (storage internal : Nat) (ps : PS) : Outcome3 PS → Prop :=
121	  Guarded (NewPoolPre ps.s storage internal) (newPoolEff ps storage internal)
122	
123	/-! ## `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4) -/
124	
125	/-- First free entry of a list of slots, counted from `i`. -/
126	def firstFreeF : Nat → List Slot → Option Nat
127	  | _, [] => none
128	  | i, sl :: l => if sl.live then firstFreeF (i + 1) l else some i
129	
130	/-- First free entry of a pool (report (f): the material does not say which free entry). -/
131	def firstFree (pl : Pool) : Option Nat := firstFreeF 0 pl.slots
132	
133	/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4): the right to update the pool value;
134	`dst` a usable leaf, not `Init`, holding no active authority, under exercisable `Modify`. The size
135	of a handle is not represented: MM-03 has no sizes (report (f)). -/
136	def AllocSlotStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) : Prop :=
137	  PoolRight k s pl via ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
138	    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧
139	    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
140	      True
141	
142	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) :
143	    Decidable (AllocSlotStatic k s pl via dst) := by
144	  unfold AllocSlotStatic; infer_instance
145	
146	/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the entry becomes live,
147	its content is not changed (the material says it stays `Uninit`, which holds when it was `Uninit`:
148	report, (g)), the handle is written into `dst`, which alone becomes `Init`. -/
149	def allocSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PS :=
150	  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) with s := write3Eff ps.s [dst] }
151	
152	/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` into its destination (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`). -/
153	def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
154	  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩
155	
156	/-- `allocSlot pool dst : ok | fail | reject` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when a static
157	precondition fails or the pool does not exist; `fail`, state unchanged, when no entry is free;
158	`ok` otherwise, on the first free entry. -/
159	inductive AllocSlotStep (k : K) (j via dst : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
160	  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl →
161	      AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst → firstFree pl = some i → pl.slots[i]? = some sl →
162	      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok (allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst))
163	  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
164	      firstFree pl = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.fail ps)
165	  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
166	      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject
167	  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject
168	
169	/-! ## `resolve h m` and `resolveMany hs m` (material §4) -/
170	
171	/-- The handle designates a live entry of the pool, at its generation (material §4, `resolve`:
172	`fail` "si `h.id` n'est pas l'identité du pool, si `h.gen` diffère de la génération de l'entrée,
173	ou si l'entrée est libre"). A slot index outside the pool designates no entry (report (f)). -/
174	def HandleOK (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
175	  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False
176	
177	instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK pl h) := by
178	  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance
179	
180	/-- Right of the pool value to exercise `internal` at mode `m` (material §4, `resolve`): the
181	precondition of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1) of the companion, from `internal`, on the whole storage.
182	It reads the effective mode of `internal`, so an active `Modify` companion rejects every new
183	resolution, whatever the handles (material §4, H31a). -/
184	def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop := DerivePre s pl.internal pl.storage m
185	
186	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
187	  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance
188	
189	/-- State after the compound borrow of one entry (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`,
190	derived from `internal` on the storage, then the entry authority `s.A.length + 1`, derived from the
191	companion on the place `q` of the entry, both at mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
192	def resolveS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
193	  deriveEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length q m
194	
195	/-- `resolve h m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when
196	the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged, when the handle is stale, of another pool or names
197	a free entry; `ok` with the compound borrow, recorded with the resolved generation. The derive of
198	the entry is a kernel step: its precondition is checked (`noEntry`). -/
199	inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
200	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → HandleOK pl h →
201	      pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
202	      DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m →
203	      ResolveStep j h m ps (.ok { ps with
204	        s := resolveS ps.s pl sl.place m
205	        res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
206	          [(ps.s.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
207	  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
208	      ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps)
209	  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
210	      ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
211	  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
212	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
213	      ¬ DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m →
214	      ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
215	  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
216	
217	/-- The handles of a batch all designate live entries of the pool at their generation, and pairwise
218	distinct entries (material §4, `resolveMany`: `fail` "si un handle est périmé ou d'un autre pool,
219	ou si deux handles désignent la même entrée"). -/
220	def BatchOK (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : Prop :=
221	  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK pl h) ∧ (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup
222	
223	instance (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : Decidable (BatchOK pl hs) := by
224	  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance
225	
226	/-- Regions of the entries of a batch: the footprint of each designated entry. -/
227	def batchRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
228	  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)
229	
230	/-- State after the compound borrow of a batch (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`, then one
231	entry authority per handle by `split` of the companion (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
232	def resolveManyS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
233	  splitEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length (batchRegions s pl hs)
234	
235	/-- Entry authorities of a batch with their slot and generation: the `i`-th split authority has the
236	identity `c + 1 + i` for the companion `c`. -/
237	def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
238	  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs
239	
240	/-- `resolveMany hs m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject`
241	when the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged and no authority created (atomicity), when the
242	batch is not valid; `ok` with the compound borrow when the `split` of the companion is accepted,
243	`reject` otherwise (`noSplit`). -/
244	inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) :
245	    POutcome → Prop where
246	  | ok {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → BatchOK pl hs →
247	      SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
248	        (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) →
249	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok { ps with
250	        s := resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m
251	        res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
252	          batchEntries ps.s.A.length hs⟩] })
253	  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ BatchOK pl hs →
254	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps)
255	  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
256	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
257	  | noSplit {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → BatchOK pl hs →
258	      ¬ SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
259	        (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) →
260	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
261	  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
262	
263	/-! ## `unresolve` (material §4) -/
264	
265	/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (MM-03.3 §3, O3); `none` as soon as a release is
266	rejected. -/
267	def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
268	  | s, [] => some s
269	  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none
270	
271	/-- The resolution whose companion is `c`. -/
272	def findRes (ps : PS) (c : Nat) : Option Res := ps.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c
273	
274	/-- `unresolve` of the resolution of companion `c` as a relation (material §4: "`release` des
275	autorités d'entrée, puis de la compagne"): `ok` when every release is accepted, `reject`
276	otherwise or when `c` is no companion. -/
277	inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
278	  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes ps c = some r →
279	      releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) = some s' →
280	      UnresolveStep c ps (.ok { ps with s := s' })
281	  | reject {r : Res} : findRes ps c = some r →
282	      releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) = none → UnresolveStep c ps .reject
283	  | none : findRes ps c = none → UnresolveStep c ps .reject
284	
285	/-! ## `freeSlot h` (material §4) -/
286	
287	/-- The handle is current for the pool (material §4, `freeSlot`: `fail` "si `h` est périmé ou d'un
288	autre pool"): same identity, an existing entry of the same generation. -/
289	def HandleCur (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
290	  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen) False
291	
292	instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleCur pl h) := by
293	  unfold HandleCur; infer_instance
294	
295	/-- An active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the place `q` of an entry
296	(material §4, `freeSlot`: `reject` "si une autorité active dérivée de `internal` couvre
297	l'entrée"). -/
298	def EntryBorrowed (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
299	  ∃ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j ∧ pl.internal ∈ s.ancs j ∧
300	    ∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q
301	
302	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (EntryBorrowed s pl q) := by
303	  unfold EntryBorrowed; infer_instance
304	
305	/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the end of the content of
306	the entry by `endUse` (MM-03.3 §3, O12), then the entry is free and its generation incremented. -/
307	def freeSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PS :=
308	  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) with

1345	    have hm₂ := hsl sl₂ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₂')
1346	    exact hd i₁ i₂ sl₁ sl₂ hne h₁' h₂' l ((fp _ hm₁ l).1 hl₁) ((fp _ hm₂ l).1 hl₂)
1347	  · obtain ⟨sl, hs, p⟩ := shape_place e.symm hsl'
1348	    rw [← p] at hl
1349	    rw [← e'.2.1]
1350	    exact (fp _ hst l).2 (hin sl hs l ((fp _ (hsl sl hs) l).1 hl))
1351	
1352	/-- `EntriesDisjoint` holds on every reached state (material §4, `PoolInv` first clause): the
1353	entries of `newPool` are the children of the storage, and footprints do not change. -/
1354	theorem pool_entries_disjoint {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
1355	    (h : PReach k statics ps) : EntriesDisjoint ps := by
1356	  induction h with
1357	  | init => intro pl hpl; simp [PS.init] at hpl
1358	  | step hr hs ih =>
1359	    rename_i ps ps'

1	import Ern.MM03

3	/-!
4	# Handle pool (jalon 3, step 1)
5	
6	A library instance of the access discipline, like the arena (MM-03.3 §6): the handle pool of the
7	jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2, §4). A handle is data and carries no authority. A
8	resolution is a compound borrow made of kernel operations of `Ern.MM03`, which this module does
9	not modify: a companion derived from `internal` on the whole storage, then one entry authority per
10	resolved handle, derived from the companion (`derive` for `resolve`, `split` for `resolveMany`).
11	`unresolve` is a sequence of `release`, `freeSlot` an `endUse` of the entry content, `allocSlot` a
12	`write3` of the handle into its destination. The pool entries live beside the kernel state, like
13	the arena entries of MM-03.3.8 but outside `S3`, so the kernel is unchanged.
14	
15	`PReach` extends `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10) with the pool operations; every pool step is a chain of
16	kernel steps (`pReach_reachable`). Representation choices that the material does not fix are listed
17	in the jalon-3 report, (f).
18	-/
19	
20	namespace Ern.HandlePool
21	
22	open Ern.MM03
23	
24	/-! ## State (material §4) -/
25	
26	/-- Entry of a pool (material §4: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`): `place` is a part of the
27	pool storage. -/
28	structure Slot where
29	  place : Nat
30	  gen : Nat
31	  live : Bool
32	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
33	
34	/-- Pool entry (material §4: `{id, storage, internal, slots}`), abstract like the arena entry of
35	MM-03.3.8. The pool value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (material §4,
36	"même règle que F1"). -/
37	structure Pool where
38	  id : Nat
39	  storage : Nat
40	  internal : Nat
41	  slots : List Slot
42	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
43	
44	/-- Handle (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`): data of fixed size, no authority. -/
45	structure Handle where
46	  id : Nat
47	  slot : Nat
48	  gen : Nat
49	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
50	
51	/-- Ghost record of a resolution (material §4, compound borrow): identity and `internal` of the
52	pool, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities, each tagged with its slot and the
53	resolved generation ("étiquetée de la génération résolue"). Read by no operation except
54	`unresolve`, which looks up the entries of a companion. -/
55	structure Res where
56	  pool : Nat
57	  internal : Nat
58	  comp : Nat
59	  mode : Mode
60	  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
61	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
62	
63	/-- Kernel state with the pool entries (material §4), the next fresh pool identity ("jamais
64	réutilisée pendant l'exécution") and the ghost record of resolutions. -/
65	structure PS where
66	  s : S3
67	  pools : List Pool
68	  nId : Nat
69	  res : List Res
70	
71	/-- Outcomes of a pool operation (material §4: `ok | fail | reject`): `fail` is a defined failure
72	that leaves the state unchanged, as for `alloc` and `issue` (MM-03.3 §3.1). -/
73	inductive POutcome where
74	  | ok (ps : PS)
75	  | fail (ps : PS)
76	  | reject
77	
78	/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse the metadata right
79	and the arena invariant of MM-03.3 §6 (`MetaRight`, `ArenaInv`). -/
80	def Pool.asArena (pl : Pool) : Arena := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩
81	
82	/-- Right to update the pool value (material §4, `allocSlot` and `freeSlot`: "`Modify` exerçable
83	ou `writeShared` sur métadonnées `SharedMutable`"): the metadata right of the arena (MM-03.3 §6,
84	`MetaRight`), read on the holder of `internal`. -/
85	def PoolRight (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) : Prop := MetaRight k s pl.asArena via
86	
87	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via : Nat) :
88	    Decidable (PoolRight k s pl via) := by
89	  unfold PoolRight; infer_instance
90	
91	/-- Place of slot `i` (0 if the slot does not exist). -/
92	def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0
93	
94	/-- The pool with its slot `i` replaced. -/
95	def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }
96	
97	/-- The extended state with its pool `j` replaced. -/
98	def setPool (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) : PS := { ps with pools := ps.pools.set j pl }
99	
100	/-! ## `newPool storage internal` (material §4) -/
101	
102	/-- Preconditions of `newPool storage internal` (material §4: "préconditions de `newArena` (F1, F2,
103	J1)"): those of `newArena` (MM-03.3 §6, O17), read literally, so clause 4 speaks of the arenas of
104	the state. -/
105	def NewPoolPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop := NewArenaPre s storage internal
106	
107	instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewPoolPre s storage internal) := by
108	  unfold NewPoolPre; infer_instance
109	
110	/-- Effect of `newPool storage internal` (material §4): a pool with a fresh identity, one free
111	entry of generation 0 per child of the storage (the entries are the parts of `storage`, report (f)),
112	and the kernel state unchanged. -/
113	def newPoolEff (ps : PS) (storage internal : Nat) : PS :=
114	  { ps with
115	    pools := ps.pools ++ [⟨ps.nId, storage, internal,
116	      (kids ps.s.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
117	    nId := ps.nId + 1 }
118	
119	/-- `newPool storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (material §4). -/
120	def NewPoolStep (storage internal : Nat) (ps : PS) : Outcome3 PS → Prop :=
121	  Guarded (NewPoolPre ps.s storage internal) (newPoolEff ps storage internal)
122	
123	/-! ## `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4) -/
124	
125	/-- First free entry of a list of slots, counted from `i`. -/
126	def firstFreeF : Nat → List Slot → Option Nat
127	  | _, [] => none
128	  | i, sl :: l => if sl.live then firstFreeF (i + 1) l else some i
129	
130	/-- First free entry of a pool (report (f): the material does not say which free entry). -/
131	def firstFree (pl : Pool) : Option Nat := firstFreeF 0 pl.slots
132	
133	/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot pool dst` (material §4): the right to update the pool value;
134	`dst` a usable leaf, not `Init`, holding no active authority, under exercisable `Modify`. The size
135	of a handle is not represented: MM-03 has no sizes (report (f)). -/
136	def AllocSlotStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) : Prop :=
137	  PoolRight k s pl via ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
138	    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧
139	    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
140	      True
141	
142	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (via dst : Nat) :
143	    Decidable (AllocSlotStatic k s pl via dst) := by
144	  unfold AllocSlotStatic; infer_instance
145	
146	/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the entry becomes live,
147	its content is not changed (the material says it stays `Uninit`, which holds when it was `Uninit`:
148	report, (g)), the handle is written into `dst`, which alone becomes `Init`. -/
149	def allocSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PS :=
150	  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) with s := write3Eff ps.s [dst] }
151	
152	/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` into its destination (material §4: `(id, slot, gen)`). -/
153	def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
154	  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩
155	
156	/-- `allocSlot pool dst : ok | fail | reject` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when a static
157	precondition fails or the pool does not exist; `fail`, state unchanged, when no entry is free;
158	`ok` otherwise, on the first free entry. -/
159	inductive AllocSlotStep (k : K) (j via dst : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
160	  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl →
161	      AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst → firstFree pl = some i → pl.slots[i]? = some sl →
162	      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok (allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst))
163	  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
164	      firstFree pl = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.fail ps)
165	  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst →
166	      AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject
167	  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps .reject
168	
169	/-! ## `resolve h m` and `resolveMany hs m` (material §4) -/
170	
171	/-- The handle designates a live entry of the pool, at its generation (material §4, `resolve`:
172	`fail` "si `h.id` n'est pas l'identité du pool, si `h.gen` diffère de la génération de l'entrée,
173	ou si l'entrée est libre"). A slot index outside the pool designates no entry (report (f)). -/
174	def HandleOK (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
175	  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False
176	
177	instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK pl h) := by
178	  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance
179	
180	/-- Right of the pool value to exercise `internal` at mode `m` (material §4, `resolve`): the
181	precondition of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1) of the companion, from `internal`, on the whole storage.
182	It reads the effective mode of `internal`, so an active `Modify` companion rejects every new
183	resolution, whatever the handles (material §4, H31a). -/
184	def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop := DerivePre s pl.internal pl.storage m
185	
186	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
187	  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance
188	
189	/-- State after the compound borrow of one entry (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`,
190	derived from `internal` on the storage, then the entry authority `s.A.length + 1`, derived from the
191	companion on the place `q` of the entry, both at mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
192	def resolveS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
193	  deriveEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length q m
194	
195	/-- `resolve h m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject` when
196	the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged, when the handle is stale, of another pool or names
197	a free entry; `ok` with the compound borrow, recorded with the resolved generation. The derive of
198	the entry is a kernel step: its precondition is checked (`noEntry`). -/
199	inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
200	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → HandleOK pl h →
201	      pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
202	      DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m →
203	      ResolveStep j h m ps (.ok { ps with
204	        s := resolveS ps.s pl sl.place m
205	        res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
206	          [(ps.s.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
207	  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
208	      ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps)
209	  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
210	      ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
211	  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
212	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
213	      ¬ DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m →
214	      ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
215	  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m ps .reject
216	
217	/-- The handles of a batch all designate live entries of the pool at their generation, and pairwise
218	distinct entries (material §4, `resolveMany`: `fail` "si un handle est périmé ou d'un autre pool,
219	ou si deux handles désignent la même entrée"). -/
220	def BatchOK (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : Prop :=
221	  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK pl h) ∧ (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup
222	
223	instance (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : Decidable (BatchOK pl hs) := by
224	  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance
225	
226	/-- Regions of the entries of a batch: the footprint of each designated entry. -/
227	def batchRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
228	  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)
229	
230	/-- State after the compound borrow of a batch (material §4): the companion `s.A.length`, then one
231	entry authority per handle by `split` of the companion (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
232	def resolveManyS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
233	  splitEff (deriveEff s pl.internal pl.storage m) s.A.length (batchRegions s pl hs)
234	
235	/-- Entry authorities of a batch with their slot and generation: the `i`-th split authority has the
236	identity `c + 1 + i` for the companion `c`. -/
237	def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
238	  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs
239	
240	/-- `resolveMany hs m : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4): `reject`
241	when the right fails; then `fail`, state unchanged and no authority created (atomicity), when the
242	batch is not valid; `ok` with the compound borrow when the `split` of the companion is accepted,
243	`reject` otherwise (`noSplit`). -/
244	inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (ps : PS) :
245	    POutcome → Prop where
246	  | ok {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → BatchOK pl hs →
247	      SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
248	        (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) →
249	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok { ps with
250	        s := resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m
251	        res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
252	          batchEntries ps.s.A.length hs⟩] })
253	  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ BatchOK pl hs →
254	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps)
255	  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight ps.s pl m →
256	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
257	  | noSplit {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → BatchOK pl hs →
258	      ¬ SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
259	        (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) →
260	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
261	  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps .reject
262	
263	/-! ## `unresolve` (material §4) -/
264	
265	/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (MM-03.3 §3, O3); `none` as soon as a release is
266	rejected. -/
267	def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
268	  | s, [] => some s
269	  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none
270	
271	/-- The resolution whose companion is `c`. -/
272	def findRes (ps : PS) (c : Nat) : Option Res := ps.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c
273	
274	/-- `unresolve` of the resolution of companion `c` as a relation (material §4: "`release` des
275	autorités d'entrée, puis de la compagne"): `ok` when every release is accepted, `reject`
276	otherwise or when `c` is no companion. -/
277	inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
278	  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes ps c = some r →
279	      releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) = some s' →
280	      UnresolveStep c ps (.ok { ps with s := s' })
281	  | reject {r : Res} : findRes ps c = some r →
282	      releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) = none → UnresolveStep c ps .reject
283	  | none : findRes ps c = none → UnresolveStep c ps .reject
284	
285	/-! ## `freeSlot h` (material §4) -/
286	
287	/-- The handle is current for the pool (material §4, `freeSlot`: `fail` "si `h` est périmé ou d'un
288	autre pool"): same identity, an existing entry of the same generation. -/
289	def HandleCur (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
290	  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen) False
291	
292	instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleCur pl h) := by
293	  unfold HandleCur; infer_instance
294	
295	/-- An active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the place `q` of an entry
296	(material §4, `freeSlot`: `reject` "si une autorité active dérivée de `internal` couvre
297	l'entrée"). -/
298	def EntryBorrowed (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
299	  ∃ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j ∧ pl.internal ∈ s.ancs j ∧
300	    ∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q
301	
302	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (EntryBorrowed s pl q) := by
303	  unfold EntryBorrowed; infer_instance
304	
305	/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on the entry `i` of the pool `j` (material §4): the end of the content of
306	the entry by `endUse` (MM-03.3 §3, O12), then the entry is free and its generation incremented. -/
307	def freeSlotEff (ps : PS) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PS :=
308	  { setPool ps j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) with
309	    s := endUseEff ps.s sl.place }
310	
311	/-- `freeSlot h : ok | fail | reject` on the pool `j` as a relation (material §4), in order:
312	`reject` without the right to update the pool value; `fail`, state unchanged, for a stale handle
313	or one of another pool; `reject` when an active authority derived from `internal` covers the
314	entry; `reject` when a precondition of `endUse` fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
315	inductive FreeSlotStep (k : K) (j via : Nat) (h : Handle) (ps : PS) : POutcome → Prop where
316	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
317	      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
318	      EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place →
319	      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok (freeSlotEff ps j pl h.slot sl))
320	  | fail {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via → ¬ HandleCur pl h →
321	      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.fail ps)
322	  | reject {pl : Pool} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
323	      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
324	  | borrowed {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
325	      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
326	      FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
327	  | endUse {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : ps.pools[j]? = some pl → PoolRight k ps.s pl via →
328	      HandleCur pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place →
329	      ¬ EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place → FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
330	  | none : ps.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep k j via h ps .reject
331	
332	/-! ## Reachability extended with the pool (material §4, "intégration à `Reachable`") -/
333	
334	/-- One step of the extended machine: a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10, `Step`) on the kernel
335	state, or an `ok` pool operation (material §4). -/
336	inductive PStep (k : K) : PS → PS → Prop where
337	  | kernel {ps : PS} {s' : S3} : Step k ps.s s' → PStep k ps { ps with s := s' }
338	  | newPool {ps ps' : PS} {st i : Nat} : NewPoolStep st i ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
339	  | allocSlot {ps ps' : PS} {j via dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok ps') →
340	      PStep k ps ps'
341	  | resolve {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} : ResolveStep j h m ps (.ok ps') →
342	      PStep k ps ps'
343	  | resolveMany {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
344	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
345	  | unresolve {ps ps' : PS} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c ps (.ok ps') → PStep k ps ps'
346	  | freeSlot {ps ps' : PS} {j via : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok ps') →
347	      PStep k ps ps'
348	
349	/-- Initial extended state: `S3.init statics` (MM-03.3.9), no pool, no resolution. -/
350	def PS.init (statics : Statics) : PS := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩
351	
352	/-- States reached from the initial state by kernel, arena and pool steps (material §4, extension of
353	`Reachable`, MM-03.3 §10). -/
354	inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PS → Prop where
355	  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) → PReach k statics (PS.init statics)
356	  | step {ps ps' : PS} : PReach k statics ps → PStep k ps ps' → PReach k statics ps'
357	
358	/-! ## Kernel steps keep authorities and footprints (MM-03.3 §3–6) -/
359

47	  | .endUse p => if EndUsePre k s p then some (endUseEff s p) else none
48	  | .free p auth => if FreePre k s p auth then some (freeEff s p) else none
49	  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
50	    if (rootIdx ls).length = 1 ∧ AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s then
51	      some (allocEff s pr ow ls) else none
52	  | .newArena st i => if NewArenaPre s st i then some (newArenaEff s st i) else none
53	  | .issue i via region dst =>
54	    match s.arenas[i]? with
55	    | some ar =>
56	      if IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧ Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧
57	          AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 then
58	        some (arenaSet (issueEff s ar region dst).1 i (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
59	      else none
60	    | none => none
61	  | .reset i via => if ResetAtPre k s i via then some (resetAtEff s i) else none
62	  | .store a p => if StorePre s a p then some (storeEff s a p) else none

66	theorem step3exec_sound {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]
67	    [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone]
68	    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)]

70	    (h : step3exec k s op = some s') : Step3 k op s s' := by
71	  cases op <;> simp only [step3exec] at h
72	  all_goals first
73	    | (split at h
74	       · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
75	         first
76	           | exact Guarded.ok hp
77	           | exact ⟨hp.1, Guarded.ok hp.2⟩
78	           | exact ⟨by
79	               obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hp
80	               match hr : rootIdx _, h1 with
81	               | [i], _ => exact ⟨i, rfl⟩, .ok hp.2.1 hp.2.2⟩
82	       · cases h)
83	    | (split at h
84	       · rename_i ar har
85	         split at h
86	         · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
87	           exact .ok har (.ok hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2)
88	         · cases h
89	       · cases h)

113	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]

119	/-- One translated step (`SimRun.step`): the `ok` MM-03 step, its obligations, then the ghost and
120	the MM-02 state after the associated sequence (K4, L6). -/
121	def sexec (st : SSt) (op : Op3) : Option SSt :=
122	  match step3exec k st.1 op with
123	  | some s3' =>
124	    if Oblig k C ObR ObW π op st.1 s3' st.2.1 st.2.2 then
125	      some (s3', provStep op st.1 st.2.1, exec st.2.2 (assoc π op st.1 st.2.2))
126	    else none
127	  | none => none

129	/-- Translated run of a list of operations, in order of execution. -/
130	def srun (st : SSt) : List Op3 → Option SSt
131	  | [] => some st
132	  | op :: ops => (sexec k C ObR ObW π st op).bind fun st' => srun st' ops

139	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
140	  {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} [∀ a b, Decidable (C a b)] {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}

144	/-- A successful translated run extends a `SimRun`. -/
145	theorem srun_sound : ∀ {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
146	    {s2 : MM02.State} {ops' : List Op3} {st : SSt},
147	    SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → srun k C ObR ObW π (s3, pv, s2) ops' = some st →
148	    ∃ os', SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (ops'.reverse ++ ops) st.1 st.2.1 os' st.2.2
149	  | _, _, _, os, _, [], st, h, he => by
150	    simp only [srun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact ⟨os, h⟩
151	  | ops, s3, pv, os, s2, op :: ops', st, h, he => by
152	    simp only [srun] at he
153	    cases hx : sexec k C ObR ObW π (s3, pv, s2) op with
154	    | none => rw [hx] at he; cases he
155	    | some st₁ =>
156	      rw [hx] at he
157	      simp only [sexec] at hx
158	      cases hs : step3exec k s3 op with
159	      | none => rw [hs] at hx; cases hx
160	      | some s3' =>
161	        rw [hs] at hx
162	        simp only at hx
163	        split at hx
164	        · rename_i hob
165	          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hx; subst hx
166	          obtain ⟨os', h2⟩ := srun_sound (h.step (step3exec_sound hs) hob) he
167	          exact ⟨os', by simpa [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc] using h2⟩
168	        · cases hx

170	theorem srun_append : ∀ (st : SSt) (ops ops' : List Op3),
171	    srun k C ObR ObW π st (ops ++ ops') =
172	      (srun k C ObR ObW π st ops).bind fun st' => srun k C ObR ObW π st' ops'
173	  | st, [], ops' => by simp [srun]
174	  | st, op :: ops, ops' => by
175	    simp only [List.cons_append, srun]
176	    cases sexec k C ObR ObW π st op with
177	    | none => rfl
178	    | some st₁ => simp only [Option.bind_some]; exact srun_append st₁ ops ops'
179	
180	/-- A successful translated step is a labelled MM-03 step with its obligations. -/
181	theorem sexec_step {st st' : SSt} {op : Op3} (h : sexec k C ObR ObW π st op = some st') :
182	    ∃ s3', Step3 k op st.1 s3' ∧ Oblig k C ObR ObW π op st.1 s3' st.2.1 st.2.2 ∧
183	      st' = (s3', provStep op st.1 st.2.1, exec st.2.2 (assoc π op st.1 st.2.2)) := by
184	  simp only [sexec] at h
185	  cases hs : step3exec k st.1 op with
186	  | none => rw [hs] at h; cases h
187	  | some s3' =>
188	    rw [hs] at h
189	    simp only at h
190	    split at h
191	    · rename_i hob
192	      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
193	      exact ⟨s3', step3exec_sound hs, hob, h.symm⟩
194	    · cases h
195	
196	end RunSound

200	/-- Root place of `q`: the last element of its chain of parents (MM-03.3.2). -/
201	def rootOf (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Nat := (chain (parentOf P) q).getLastD q
202	
203	/-- Number of root places below `r`: the MM-02 identity of the allocation of the root `r` when every
204	root is laid out in its own allocation, in index order (K2). -/
205	def rootRank (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Nat :=
206	  ((List.range r).filter fun i => decide (i < P.length ∧ parentOf P i = none)).length
207	
208	/-- Number of leaves of the root of `l` below `l`. -/
209	def leafRank (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Nat :=
210	  ((List.range l).filter fun i => decide (i < P.length ∧ isLeaf P i ∧ rootOf P i = rootOf P l)).length
211	
212	/-- Layout of the runs (K1): a place in the allocation of its root, a leaf at 8 times its rank,
213	8 bytes; size zero for the roots of `z`. -/
214	def autoL (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Layout := fun q =>
215	  if rootOf P q ∈ z then ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 0, 0⟩
216	  else ⟨rootRank P (rootOf P q), 8 * leafRank P q, 8⟩
217	
218	/-- Geometry of the allocation of the root `r` (K2): 8 bytes per leaf, aligned on 8; size zero for
219	the roots of `z`. -/
220	def autoG (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Nat → Geom := fun r =>
221	  if r ∈ z then ⟨0, 0, 8⟩ else ⟨0, 8 * (footprint P r).length, 8⟩
222	
223	/-- Compatibility by equality of tokens (`TokCompat`, as in `CaseSim`). -/
224	abbrev Ceq : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun a d => a = d
225	
226	/-- Parameters of a run whose final places are `P` (`Params`): the layout and geometry above, the
227	tokens, placement, pointer encoding and bytes of `CaseSim`. -/
228	def piOf (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) : Params :=
229	  ⟨autoL P z, fun f => 100 + f, fun pr => 6 + pr, topPlacement, autoG P z, CaseSim.pe, CaseSim.w⟩
230	
231	theorem piOf_geom (P : List Place) (z : List Nat) (r : Nat) :
232	    0 < ((piOf P z).geom r).align ∧ MM02.Pow2 ((piOf P z).geom r).align := by
233	  simp only [piOf, autoG]
234	  split <;> exact ⟨Nat.succ_pos 7, ⟨3, rfl⟩⟩

279	theorem simRun_of {statics : Statics} {P : List Place} {z : List Nat} {ops : List Op3}

281	    (hlay : NewLayout (piOf P z).L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 (piOf P z).geom
282	      (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))
283	    (hdec : DecAlong CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf (piOf P z) statics))
284	    (h : (srun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW (piOf P z) (sinit statics (piOf P z)) ops).isSome =
285	      true) :
286	    ∃ os, SimRun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW statics (piOf P z) ops.reverse
287	      (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).1 (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.1 os
288	      (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.2 := by
289	  obtain ⟨os, h'⟩ := srun_sound (SimRun.init (k := k) (C := Ceq) hsh hlay hdec)
290	    (Ern.HandlePool.some_getD (d := sinit statics (piOf P z)) h)
291	  rw [List.append_nil] at h'
292	  exact ⟨os, h'⟩

294	/-- `simulation` on a translated run: the MM-02 run from `State.empty` has only `ok` outcomes,
295	reaches the MM-02 state of the run, which is in `Repr` with the MM-03 state, reached. -/
296	theorem sim_of {statics : Statics} {P : List Place} {z : List Nat} {ops : List Op3}
297	    (hdd : DDSound k) (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)))
298	    (hlay : NewLayout (piOf P z).L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 (piOf P z).geom
299	      (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))
300	    (hdec : DecAlong CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf (piOf P z) statics))
301	    (h : (srun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW (piOf P z) (sinit statics (piOf P z)) ops).isSome =
302	      true) :
303	    ∃ os, AllOk Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty os ∧
304	      exec MM02.State.empty os = (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.2 ∧
305	      Repr (piOf P z).tok (piOf P z).ptok (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.1 (piOf P z).L
306	        (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).1 (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.2 ∧
307	      Reachable k statics (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).1 := by
308	  obtain ⟨os, h'⟩ := simRun_of hsh hlay hdec h
309	  have := simulation hdd (fun _ _ => trivial) (fun _ _ _ => trivial) topPlacement_ok
310	    (piOf_geom P z) (fun _ => rfl) h'
311	  exact ⟨os, this.1, this.2.1, this.2.2.1, this.2.2.2.1⟩

313	/-- R6 at one step of a translated run: the MM-02 sequence associated with the step `op` after the
314	prefix `ops` has only `ok` outcomes in the MM-02 state of the prefix (`simulation` on the prefix and
315	on the prefix extended by the step). -/
316	theorem step_ok_of {statics : Statics} {P : List Place} {z : List Nat} {ops : List Op3}
317	    {op : Op3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)))
318	    (hlay : NewLayout (piOf P z).L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 (piOf P z).geom
319	      (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))
320	    (hdec : DecAlong CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf (piOf P z) statics))
321	    (h : (srun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW (piOf P z) (sinit statics (piOf P z))
322	      (ops ++ [op])).isSome = true) :
323	    AllOk Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.2
324	      (assoc (piOf P z) op (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).1 (sst k statics (piOf P z) ops).2.2) := by
325	  rw [srun_append] at h
326	  cases hp : srun k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW (piOf P z) (sinit statics (piOf P z)) ops with
327	  | none => rw [hp] at h; cases h
328	  | some st₀ =>
329	    rw [hp] at h
330	    simp only [Option.bind_some, srun] at h
331	    cases hx : sexec k Ceq CaseSim.obR CaseSim.obW (piOf P z) st₀ op with
332	    | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h
333	    | some st₁ =>
334	      have hst : sst k statics (piOf P z) ops = st₀ := by simp [sst, hp]
335	      obtain ⟨os, ht⟩ := simRun_of (k := k) hsh hlay hdec (by rw [hp]; rfl)
336	      rw [hst] at ht ⊢
337	      obtain ⟨s3', hs, hob, -⟩ := sexec_step hx
338	      have h₁ := simulation hdd (fun _ _ => trivial) (fun _ _ _ => trivial) topPlacement_ok
339	        (piOf_geom P z) (fun _ => rfl) ht
340	      have h₂ := simulation hdd (fun _ _ => trivial) (fun _ _ _ => trivial) topPlacement_ok
341	        (piOf_geom P z) (fun _ => rfl) (ht.step hs hob)
342	      have := along_append.1 h₂.1
343	      rw [h₁.2.1] at this
344	      exact this.2

# ERN — Jalon 3 : matériel pour revue unique

**Objet :** validation adversariale du Memory Model (spec 1) après les jalons 1 et 2.
**Contenu :** les trois corpus mis à jour, le contrat du pool de handles, le cadrage de la décision `NoLock`, le registre des obligations inter-spécifications.
**Statut :** matériel de conception, non normatif. Version 2 : corrections de la revue unique de GPT intégrées (contrat du pool, corpus, calendrier, scénarios Weld).

## 0. Règles du jalon 3

1. **Oracle indépendant.** Le verdict attendu d'un cas vient de sa source (clause de MM-02 v0.4, de MM-03.3 v0.3, arbitrage, ou usage déclaré), jamais du comportement des modules. Un cas sans source qui tranche est marqué « à arbitrer ».
2. **Jumeau positif.** Chaque rejet a un jumeau minimal accepté : même séquence sans l'élément fautif. Un rejet qui persiste dans le jumeau est un défaut de construction.
3. **États atteints.** Chaque cas est construit depuis l'état initial par des pas autorisés.
4. **Pas de correction silencieuse.** Un verdict obtenu différent de l'attendu est rapporté avec l'état et le pas en cause.
5. **Classement.** Chaque cas relève de : noyau MM-03 (`N3`), machine MM-02 (`N2`), raffinement (`R`), instance de bibliothèque (`Lib` : arène, pool), ou d'une autre spécification (spec 2, 3, 4, 11). Les cas d'une autre spécification restent des obligations inter-spécifications ; ils ne bloquent pas la clôture du jalon 3.
6. **Couverture.** La colonne « Couvert » indique un témoin déjà produit pendant les jalons 1 et 2, quand il est identifié avec certitude. Le jalon 3 rejoue tous les cas depuis l'état initial, couverts ou non, dans un module de cas séparé.
7. **Cible des corpus.** MM3-H et MM23-H sont encodés au jalon 3 sur les brouillons, sans modifier `MM02`, `MM03` ni `MM23`. MM2-H : ses verdicts sont révisés au jalon 3, mais sa validation exécutable reste une obligation de la reconstruction de référence ; le jalon 3 ne le déclare pas validé.
8. **Écarts connus.** Un cas dont le verdict attendu repose sur une décision non encore appliquée au brouillon (MM23-H15, H16) est encodé avec le verdict obtenu, marqué « écart connu », et inscrit au registre de reconstruction. Il n'est jamais présenté comme réussi.

---

## 4. Contrat du pool de handles (instance de bibliothèque, comme l'arène)

**Principe.** Un handle est une donnée ; il ne porte aucune autorité. La résolution fournit un accès temporaire de seconde classe. Aucun drapeau d'emprunt par entrée : l'exclusivité d'une résolution `Modify` découle des règles du noyau (I1, O3.2), par la forme de l'arbre de dérivation ci-dessous.

**État de l'entrée de pool** (abstrait, comme l'entrée d'arène ; sa représentation en octets est une obligation de l'implémentation) : `{id, storage, internal, slots}`.
- `id` : identité de pool fraîche à chaque `newPool`, jamais réutilisée pendant l'exécution. Un pool détruit puis recréé, même sur le même stockage, a une autre identité.
- `slots` : chaque entrée est `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}` ; `place` est une partie de `storage`.
- La valeur pool est le détenteur de `internal` (même règle que F1). Le stockage peut être local, statique, alloué ou un bloc.

**Handle** : `(id, slot, gen)`, une donnée de taille fixe.

**Emprunt composé.** Une résolution est un emprunt composé : une autorité **compagne** dérivée de `internal` sur **tout le stockage** du pool, au mode de la résolution, détenue par le cadre courant ; puis une autorité d'**entrée** par handle résolu, dérivée **de la compagne** (sous-empreinte), au même mode, détenue par le cadre courant et étiquetée de la génération résolue. Conséquences, toutes par les règles existantes du noyau :
- la compagne ne peut être libérée tant qu'une de ses autorités d'entrée est active (O3.2) ;
- une compagne `Modify` active rend le mode effectif de `internal` absent sur tout le stockage : toute nouvelle résolution, `Modify` ou `Observe`, est rejetée, quels que soient les handles ;
- plusieurs compagnes `Observe` coexistent ; une résolution `Modify` est alors rejetée.

**Opérations**

- **`newPool storage internal`** : préconditions de `newArena` (F1, F2, J1) ; identité fraîche ; toutes les entrées libres, générations à 0.
- **`allocSlot pool dst : ok | fail | reject`** : droit de mise à jour sur la valeur pool (`Modify` exerçable ou `writeShared` sur métadonnées `SharedMutable`) ; `dst` est une feuille non `Init`, ne détenant aucune autorité active, de la taille d'un handle, `Modify` exerçable ; `fail` si aucune entrée libre (état inchangé) ; `ok` : une entrée libre devient vivante, son contenu reste `Uninit`, le handle `(id, slot, gen)` est écrit dans `dst`, qui seule passe à `Init`.
- **`resolve h m : ok | fail | reject`** (`m` = `Observe` ou `Modify`) : droit d'exercice de `internal` au mode `m` par la valeur pool ; les vérifications d'identité et de génération lisent seulement les métadonnées et précèdent toute création d'autorité ; `fail` (état inchangé) si `h.id` n'est pas l'identité du pool, si `h.gen` diffère de la génération de l'entrée, ou si l'entrée est libre ; `ok` : emprunt composé à une entrée. Une compagne déjà active n'est jamais réutilisée : chaque résolution crée la sienne.
- **`resolveMany hs m : ok | fail | reject`** : une compagne, une autorité d'entrée par handle (par `split` de la compagne) ; `fail` si un handle est périmé ou d'un autre pool, ou si deux handles désignent la même entrée ; **atomique** : en cas de `fail`, aucune autorité n'est créée. Coût dynamique explicite : vérification de distinction proportionnelle au lot. C'est la voie des requêtes ECS.
- **`unresolve`** : `release` des autorités d'entrée, puis de la compagne.
- **`freeSlot h : ok | fail | reject`** : droit de mise à jour sur la valeur pool ; `fail` si `h` est périmé ou d'un autre pool ; `reject` si une autorité active dérivée de `internal` couvre l'entrée (donc pendant toute résolution du pool, puisque chaque compagne couvre tout le stockage) ; sinon fin logique du contenu de l'entrée **selon `endUse`** (mêmes préconditions : aucune dépendance utilisable, aucune feuille épinglée ; mêmes effets : feuilles `Uninit`, autorités détenues libérées, dépendances supprimées, stockage possédé logiquement mort, sans désallocation) — `reject` si une précondition d'`endUse` échoue ; une entrée déjà `Uninit` est acceptée ; puis l'entrée devient libre et sa génération est incrémentée.

**Invariant `PoolInv`** (tout pool vivant) : entrées deux à deux disjointes et incluses dans le stockage ; toute autorité active dérivée d'une compagne du pool sur une entrée porte la génération courante de l'entrée, et l'entrée est vivante ; toute compagne active a au plus les autorités d'entrée de sa résolution pour descendants.

**Générations et identités** : `Nat` dans le modèle ; le débordement des générations et l'unicité réelle des identités de pool sont des obligations de l'implémentation, classées bibliothèque et spec 11.

**Théorèmes attendus**
- `pool_resolve_stale_fails`, `pool_resolve_other_pool_fails` ;
- `pool_no_stale_access` : aucune autorité active d'une génération périmée ;
- `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive` : sur tout état atteint, au plus une compagne `Modify` active par pool, et alors aucune compagne `Observe` — quelle que soit la séquence de `resolve`, `resolveMany`, `release`, `store`, `transfer` et `unresolve` qui y mène ;
- `pool_resolveMany_atomic` et `pool_resolveMany_distinct` ;
- `pool_freeSlot_ends_content` : après `freeSlot`, le contenu de l'entrée satisfait les effets d'`endUse` ;
- `pool_inv_preserved`, et intégration à `Reachable` dans un module séparé, noyau inchangé.

**Cas** : H30–H34b, H44, W1.

## 5. Décision `NoLock` — cadrage

**Fait établi (passe 7).** Des états atteints contiennent des autorités détenues que personne ne peut exercer, ce qui bloque un `reset` ou un `free` jusqu'à la mort d'une ressource englobante (H49–H51). Ces états respectent tous les invariants de sûreté ; la charte exclut les interblocages du contrat de sûreté (§4.1). C'est une question d'ergonomie et de progrès, pas de sûreté.

**Options**

1. **Aucune règle** (référence de comparaison). Les blocages sont admis ; les relations persistantes passent par des handles par convention.
2. **Règle locale.** Interdire qu'une opération place une autorité dans un emplacement qu'elle couvre (auto-blocage). O8 l'interdit déjà pour `store` ; le gain à mesurer porte sur `transfer` et `issue`. Ne couvre pas les cycles de longueur ≥ 2 construits par autorité auxiliaire.
3. **`NoLock` global.** Acyclicité de la relation « `b` bloque `a` », auto-blocage défini comme clause séparée, vérifiée à l'arrivée de `transfer`, `issue`, `store`.

**Mesures à produire au jalon 3, pour chaque option :**
- faux rejets sur les cas qui doivent être acceptés : H11, H19, H29b, H35–H37, H44–H47, W1–W3 ;
- blocages résiduels sur H49–H51 ;
- coût d'analyse : la vérification est-elle locale à une fonction, ou exige-t-elle une analyse globale ?

**Critère de choix** : aucune option n'est adoptée si elle rejette un cas qui doit être accepté. Entre options sans faux rejet, la moins coûteuse à analyser l'emporte.
